title: LDAC-Net: A Learnable Multi-Lag Differencing Attention-Convolution Network for Drift-Robust Recognition with Low-Cost MOX Gas Sensors
abstract: arXiv:2608.25646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Portable electronic-nose systems based on low-cost metal-oxide (MOX) gas sensors offer a practical solution for gas and odour recognition, but their signals are affected by slow chemical transients, drifting sensor offsets, scale variation, and cross-channel correlations. Existing pipelines commonly use fixed first-order temporal differencing (FOTD), which requires a manually selected lag and may discard useful response information. We propose LDAC-Net, an end-to-end learnable multi-lag differencing attention-convolution network that operates directly on multi-channel MOX signals. Its learnable differential feature enhancement front-end combines window-conditioned statistical affine normalisation, which compensates for window-specific offset and scale variation, with learnable multi-lag differencing, which weights and combines temporal differences across multiple lags. translated_title: LDAC-Net：一种可学习多滞后差分注意力卷积网络，用于低成本MOX气体传感器的漂移鲁棒识别
translated_abstract: 基于低成本金属氧化物（MOX）气体传感器的便携式电子鼻系统为气体和气味识别提供了实用解决方案，但其信号受到缓慢化学瞬态、传感器漂移偏移、尺度变化和跨通道相关性的影响。现有流程通常使用固定的一阶时间差分（FOTD），这需要手动选择滞后，并可能丢弃有用的响应信息。我们提出了LDAC-Net，一种端到端的可学习多滞后差分注意力卷积网络，直接操作多通道MOX信号。其可学习差分特征增强前端结合了窗口条件统计仿射归一化（补偿窗口特定的偏移和尺度变化）与可学习多滞后差分（加权并组合多个滞后上的时间差异）。一个紧凑的注意力卷积骨干随后建模局部时间依赖性和跨通道交互。
tldr: 提出了一种端到端可学习多滞后差分注意力卷积网络，通过自适应差分和归一化解决MOX气体传感器漂移问题，无需手动选择滞后。
en_tdlr: Proposes an end-to-end learnable multi-lag differencing attention-convolution network that adaptively handles drift in MOX gas sensors without manual lag selection.
